scripts.clean:demo: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p='dist/demo';if(fs.existsSync(p)){fs.rmSync(p,{recursive:true,force:true});console.log('Đã xóa dist/demo/');}else{console.log('dist/demo/ không tồn tại');}"
scripts.rebuild:demo: npm run clean:demo && npm run build:demo
scripts.deploy:cf: npm run build:demo && npx wrangler pages deploy dist/demo --project-name=webdrop-demo
scripts.deploy:gh: npm run build:demo && npx gh-pages -d dist/demo -b gh-pages
